requirements.text: As our next engineer on Enterprise, you should have 3+ years of software engineering experience, plus:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience.
Ability to work with customers directly, both satiating customer expectations as well and ensuring internal company strategic standards and goals are met.

Comfort talking to customers directly. You can run a technical conversation with an external engineering team, ask the questions that surface the real requirement, and say no when the right answer is a platform fix rather than a one-off.
Ability to flexibly work across multiple workstreams, thriving in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to understand complex customer success workflows and envision and build tooling to better support our bespoke system.
Strong grounding in APIs, distributed systems, and data synchronization — you've debugged something gnarly across a system boundary you didn't control.
A track record of automating away work rather than absorbing it. You get uncomfortable doing the same manual fix twice.
Ability to take ownership of an ambiguous area, define it, and drive impact — this role has no playbook yet.
Experience with e-commerce or operational systems (Shopify, ChannelAdvisor, Magento, NetSuite, ShipStation, WMS/ERP platforms) is a plus.

We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York or Seattle hub.
